description: 東京都の火山ハザードマップ [volcanoes and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都総務局. 【東京都総務局】日本国における常時監視・観測が必要な50火山のうち東京都に在する伊豆大島、新島、神津島、三宅島、八丈島、青ヶ島の火山ハザードマップ. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都総務局. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 7 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
